title: On Tolerating no noise after nine
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：tolerate　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tolerate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the elder ① tolerated no noise after nine in silence, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② tolerates no noise after nine twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ tolerate no noise after nine at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ tolerated no noise after nine before — a line in the memoir for November 1986 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Tolerating no noise after nine in silence, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ tolerate the cold better than most twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Tolerate the cold better than most at once and never mention it again.

By 1999 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ tolerates the cold better than most in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ tolerated no noise after nine again when nobody else would.

⑩ To tolerate no noise after nine, my mother said in 2004, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody tolerates no noise after nine twice over again and somebody must tolerate no noise after nine in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 容忍（一般过去式 tolerated no noise after nine：1992 年长者头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 容忍（一般现在 tolerates no noise after nine：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 容忍（不定式 to tolerate no noise after nine：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 容忍（过去完成时 had tolerated no noise after nine：1986 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 容忍（动名词 tolerating no noise after nine 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 忍受（tolerate the cold better than most：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去忍受比多数人更耐得住冷）
G. v. 忍受（tolerate the cold better than most：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 容忍（后段两处：新来的后生照例 tolerates the cold better than most，而母亲又一次 tolerated no noise after nine）

items.q: to tolerate no noise after nine
tolerated no noise after nine before
tolerate the cold better than most twice over
tolerate the cold better than most at once
tolerates the cold better than most in silence
tolerated no noise after nine again
to tolerate no noise after nine

answers.why: tolerate 意为“容忍”，1992 年长者一言不发地容忍九点以后不许有一点声响，那是村子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 tolerated。
tolerate 意为“容忍”，自那以后长者来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 tolerates。
tolerate 意为“容忍”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯容忍九点以后不许有一点声响”，此处为不定式 to tolerate no noise after nine。
tolerate 意为“容忍”，回忆录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1999 年之前就有人容忍过，故用过去完成时 had tolerated。
tolerate 意为“容忍”，长者说“容忍九点以后不许有一点声响这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 tolerating no noise after nine 作主语。
tolerate 意为“忍受”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去忍受比多数人更耐得住冷”，should ever 之后用原形 tolerate the cold better than most。
tolerate 意为“忍受”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻忍受比多数人更耐得住冷（tolerate the cold better than most at once），以后再也不要提起。
tolerate 意为“容忍”，新来的后生每个年头都照例忍受比多数人更耐得住冷，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 tolerates。
tolerate 意为“容忍”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地容忍九点以后不许有一点声响，用一般过去式 tolerated 叙述。
tolerate 意为“容忍”，结尾那句是母亲 2004 年的话：要容忍九点以后不许有一点声响，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和村子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 tolerate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the elder tolerated no noise after nine in silence, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder tolerates no noise after nine twice over whenever the village asks.
Tolerating no noise after nine in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever tolerate the cold better than most twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village tolerates the cold better than most in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother tolerated no noise after nine again, and the village remembered that half.
